verdict.rationale: Veo is a hosted AI video-generation service, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training opt-outs, data-use controls, or data retention policies. The docs cover creative features, and the community items discuss output quality, access, cost and moderation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
